widgets_values: Ultra-detailed macro scientific-schematic illustration of a translucent dragonfly rendered in glowing holographic glass, centered in profile against a pure black background, filling most of the frame with wings outstretched. Iridescent chromatic-aberration highlights ripple across the wing membranes and segmented thorax in shifting hues of violet, cyan, amber, and rose gold, with fine glowing vein-like structural lines threading through the transparent wings and exoskeleton. The body surface shows crisp micro-textured detail—faceted eyes, fine bristled legs, and layered abdominal segments—rendered with subtle glassy refraction and soft internal luminescence. Surrounding the creature, a dense technical HUD-style overlay of thin white grid lines, crosshairs, small diagrams, data tables, waveform graphs, and blocks of tiny illegible pseudo-scientific text is arranged in a symmetrical poster-like layout, evoking a futuristic biological analysis chart or specimen dossier. Lighting is even and diffuse, emphasizing internal glow and translucency over directional shadow, creating a high-contrast, dark-background aesthetic with sharp focus across the entire subject and crisp digital clarity in the surrounding data elements. Overall mood: clinical, high-tech, otherworldly, and precise, blending forensic entomological documentation with sci-fi holographic display design.
